mapper.select: SELECT user.userid, user.username, user.authority auth_id, auth.auth, auth.level FROM ttok.user user, ttok.cmm_auth auth WHERE user.authority = auth.auth_id AND user.userid = #{userid} AND user.userpw = hex(aes_encrypt(#{userpw},'ttokssaem_2022@')) AND user.useyn = 'Y'

SELECT E.menu_id ,E.menu ,E.menusort ,E.uri ,E.menulev ,E.icon ,D.btn_read ,D.btn_reg ,D.btn_upd ,D.btn_del ,D.btn_xlsd ,D.btn_xlsu FROM ttok.cmm_auth C ,ttok.cmm_auth_menu D ,ttok.cmm_menu E WHERE C.auth_id = D.auth_id AND D.menu_id = E.menu_id AND C.useyn = 'Y' AND E.useyn = 'Y' AND D.auth_id = #{auth_id} ORDER BY menusort
